_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The Pattern Analyst's reasoning suggests a phase transition to Belief if certain conditions are met, which aligns with the cautious bullishness of the Narrative Writer.
next_move.brains_agree: The Pattern Analyst and Narrative Writer agree on the forward call.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed index rises above 80 and ETF flows remain above 60
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed index drops below 60 or ETF flows fall below 50
